note: Frozen R3.1 policy. As POLICY_R3.json except the SVP table: max of the R3 and R3.1 development measurements (DEV_SVP_TABLE.json, DEV_SVP_TABLE_R31.json), q=89 set to 1.9 s to include the observed retry rate (DEV_LLL_DELTA.json). Speed only, never correctness.

interval_model.unit: seconds, L = number of factors, FLINT block engine, separate channels

lll: R3.1 chain (r3/jacobi_r31.py): delta 0.999, then 0.9999, then up to 4 seeded re-randomised bases; no enumeration
selection: argmin over admissible q of svp(q)+f(len_target)+f(len_anchor); tie -> larger q; use tal only if below the fallback prediction
fallback: unconditional: half_interval if |D|<2e10 for its class number (D=-p or -3p) else nodal_flint; grh: half_interval with quadclassunit
